notes.title: Luka Route Release!! Free Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949144/819e0a7fb69ca112a45f5b7515b098b6e9fcd008.jpg[/img]

[h1]Luka’s route for Red Embrace is now available for FREE![/h1]

[b]If you bought Red Embrace through Steam, you should receive an automatic update that contains Luka's free DLC route![/b]

In Luka’s route, you can enjoy:
[list]
[*][b][u]3 new CGs[/u][/b]
[*][b][u]2 new endings[/u][/b]
[*]New sfx and BG lighting variation
[/list]
Here’s what else the update includes:
[list]
[*][b][u]1 new Steam Achievement[/u][/b]
[*][b][u]Special secret reward for completing all 4 routes[/u][/b]
[*]Textbox close option
[*]A few bugfixes
[/list]
[b]Thank you all for your support and feedback! Please remember to review, share, and rate us, it really helps us out![/b]

(Stay tuned for future updates on our next BL projects!)

~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~ 

Support our future and current projects on [url=https://www.patreon.com/argentgames]Patreon[/url] for extra goodies, follow our [url=https://twitter.com/argent_games]Twitter[/url] for shenanigans, and join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/5SrFgVY]Discord[/url] to chat with the devs (and other yaoi/visual novel fans!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949144/8e2f0c7b2b8cd11fdbeae556635dfff93818f721.png[/img]

notes.title: Final achievement bugfix!
notes.notes:
Hello RE players!

We've had a few reports of the final achievement in Red Embrace (Antediluvian) being unattainable. As of today's patch, it should now be fixed!

If you had 99% completion on the game before, just [u][b]start a new game[/b][/u] to activate the fruits of your efforts~

Thanks again for your support, and we hope you all continue to enjoy Red Embrace! <3

-AG Team
